body.statement: For any finite collection of EasyRCA lag-specific transmission queries defined on one fixed coordinate set and alphabet family \(\mathcal A\), rank only pairs for which \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)=\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\); if their population scores are separated by a fixed positive margin, the plug-in ranking is consistent, while every failed query is accompanied by its \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{lag}}(\mathcal A)\) certificate and is excluded rather than assigned a causal score.
body.justification: The proposition states the precise consumer contract: identified comparisons are ranked and unresolved comparisons trigger certified abstention.
body.gap: EasyRCA assumes jointly independent noises and compares adjustment-based direct effects; it does not propagate latent-confounding identification failures into its ranking.
body.consumer: Operators receive a causal ranking only where the summary abstraction supports one, with explicit reasons for missing edges.
